title: Initial Sunday opportunity review: injury-contingent volume and production limits

research_window_utc.note: Bounded initial public-source review. Not a full Sunday-final or full-week grade.

purpose: Preserve source-qualified public NFL facts and general evaluation lessons without creating a league decision.

examples.topic: Injury-contingent workload is not a permanent role
examples.verified_public_fact: Allen: 24 rushes, 116 yards, 1 rush TD; prior week: 14 rushes, 59 yards. Hall inactive.
examples.fact_confidence: HIGH for stated official counts and availability

sources.material_reviewed: Official player log, current and prior-week carries.

examples.analytical_lesson: Substantial Allen realized volume is conditional on Hall absence. The prior-week comparison is descriptive and does not control for health or game environment. No permanent takeover or future touch split is established.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: Subsequent official Hall status, complete snaps/routes, situational assignments and comparable games.

examples.topic: Receiving-production concentration is not target share
examples.verified_public_fact: Wilson: 7 receptions, 104 yards, 1 TD. Team gross passing yards: 182.

calculated_quantity.unit: percent of team gross passing yards

examples.analytical_lesson: A high share of produced yards can reflect a small number of productive plays. Without targets/routes, this does not establish a changed opportunity rate.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: Provider-defined targets, routes and comparable prior denominators.

examples.topic: An injury-affected outcome does not identify healthy opportunity
examples.verified_public_fact: Shipley: 5 carries, 6 rush yards, 1 rush TD; 1 catch, 7 receiving yards. Foot-injury exit; no return. Barkley inactive.

sources.material_reviewed: Official report of Shipley foot-injury exit/no return and Barkley absence.

examples.analytical_lesson: Retain the injury-affected result without post-hoc exclusion. A touchdown cannot establish sufficient volume; the injury prevents a confident healthy full-game counterfactual. Carries and scrimmage touches are distinct units. This public record does not reconstruct any pregame fantasy forecast or grade a league decision.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: Subsequent official injury updates and complete participation/assignment evidence; future role remains unresolved.
examples.freshness_note: Philadelphia postgame reporting predates the earlier 21:20 UTC review; this is verified comparison context, not newly breaking news.

examples.topic: A live feed snapshot is not a verified final result
examples.verified_public_fact: Official page at 23:43:45 UTC: LIVE Q4 00:54. Final not verified.

sources.material_reviewed: Official page still displayed LIVE Q4 00:54, San Francisco 32-Seattle 29; final outcome not verified.

examples.analytical_lesson: The feed may lag. This states what the page displayed, not the actual game status at publication. No Seattle final usage or performance grade is inferred.
examples.additional_evidence_needed: An explicitly final official box and complete usage data.

methodological_limits: SNF had not started within this research window; no SNF outcome or full-week grade is asserted.
Official counts may later be corrected. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.
Several articles about one event corroborate the event but do not create independent samples.
One game does not establish signal skill, a durable player-role change, source ranking or calibration.
No league availability, roster move, bid, lineup change, trade or adopted learning rule is established by this educational record.
forecast_handling: Preserve contemporaneous forecasts unchanged and append later observations with distinct timestamps. Do not backfill pregame confidence from a known result.
future_corrections: Preserve this record and add a separately dated correction if later official evidence changes a count or interpretation.

general_fantasy_implications.text: For longer-horizon player evaluation, distinguish temporary injury replacement volume from evidence of sustainable participation and target earning. One high-production game alone is insufficient to establish lasting roster value.
When evaluating an apparent emerging receiver, ask whether routes and targets persisted across comparable games before relying on a single receiving-yard concentration result.
Keep public NFL news separate from any authenticated league state. A later decision needs its own contemporaneous evidence and immutable record; this education entry is not that decision.

research_hypotheses.claim: Availability-conditioned opportunity projections outperform an unconditioned baseline on future comparable games.
research_hypotheses.test: Prespecify eligible games and injury strata, preserve all outcomes including injury-affected games, compare chronological held-out carry errors.

research_hypotheses.claim: Persistent target/route changes are more informative for future opportunity than single-game receiving-yard concentration.
research_hypotheses.test: Acquire defined target and route denominators and compare subsequent games without selecting only successful examples.

confidence_limits: High confidence in retrieved official final counts, subject to correction. Interpretations are conditional; research hypotheses are untested. No confidence level is assigned to unestimated future probabilities or decision value.
